stem.text: A car travelling at a steady speed in a straight line passes close to a stationary observer. The observer measures the frequency of the sound from the engine.
As the car approaches, the observed frequency is $220\,\text{Hz}$. When the car moves away, the observed frequency is $180\,\text{Hz}$.
The speed of sound in air is $340\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
What is the speed of the car?
